peerGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (RCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

positions.label: Price position
positions.bandLabel: Higher relative price than most peers
positions.statement: Price position — Higher relative price than most peers: 14.9% above its local comparables; 43 of 44 similar developments with a figure have a lower relative price (a position, not a measure of value).

positions.label: Resale activity
positions.statement: Resale activity — Above peers (74.5): 5.6 resales per 100 homes a year (24 months): higher than 38 of 51 similar developments. Context, not scored: resales in 79.2% of months (24 months).

comparisonGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (RCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

profile.rule: Each line compares this development with its own comparison group; numbers from different groups are not comparable. There is no overall score.
profile.surroundingMarket: Surrounding market: other condo and EC developments within 2 km (straight line between development positions); new sales plus resales; subsales, cluster and other landed housing, HDB flats and this development are excluded. Competition, the quiet-area check and the Market backdrop use this same set.

lines.label: Entry price against comparable developments
lines.statement: 2-bedroom: median $2,360,000 ($2,233 psf, 968–1,065 sq ft; 7 resales, Jun 2025–May 2026); 6 comparable developments within 5 km: median $1,916 psf (range $1,604–2,186); 16.5% above; illustrative entry-price difference about $335,000 more. 3-bedroom: median $3,295,000 ($2,184 psf, 1,485–1,689 sq ft; 16 resales, Sep 2025–Aug 2026); 3 comparable developments within 5 km: median $1,928 psf (range $1,910–2,090); 13.3% above; illustrative entry-price difference about $386,000 more. The entry-price difference is illustrative: the median price adjusted to the comparable median psf, for a similar-size unit. A premium or a discount is not in itself an advantage or a disadvantage.

lines.label: Sustained resale activity
lines.statement: No first resale wave in the observation period: sustained activity is the observed activity.

lines.label: MRT today
lines.statement: Marine Parade MRT about 330 m, Tanjong Katong MRT about 600 m; closer than 15 of 51 similar developments (the same as 1). Straight-line distances.

lines.label: Primary schools
lines.statement: 1 within 1 km and 5 within 2 km; nearest Tanjong Katong Primary School about 670 m; more than 9 of 51 similar developments (the same as 14). Straight-line distances. MOE measures distance for school admission differently.

lines.label: Everyday amenities
lines.statement: 7 supermarkets within 1 km (nearest about 270 m), more than 36 of 51 similar developments (the same as 2); nearest hawker centre Marine Parade Central Market And Food Centre about 440 m; nearest park East Coast Park Area B about 130 m. Straight-line distances.

nearestHawker.name: Marine Parade Central Market And Food Centre

lines.label: Future transport
lines.statement: Not yet assessed: needs official LTA evidence for planned stations.

lines.label: Recorded new-launch competition
lines.statement: 8 other condo developments sold new homes within 2 km (Amber House, 31 new sales, about 330 m; Emerald of Katong, 2 new sales, about 770 m; Ardor Residence, 13 new sales, about 830 m; Tembusu Grand, 11 new sales, about 940 m; Meyer Blue, 20 new sales, about 1,340 m; Koon Seng House, 6 new sales, about 1,370 m; The Continuum, 208 new sales, about 1,450 m; K Suites, 6 new sales, about 1,500 m). Surrounding market, Oct 2025–Sep 2026: 354 other condo and EC developments within 2 km recorded 389 new sales and 624 resales (1,013 purchases); new sales were 38.4% of these purchases. Subsales (42) and this development’s own transactions are excluded. New sales as a share of local private purchases is a measure of market activity, not of supply pressure.

missing.reason: not available until the URA-based launched-unsold measure (S3) passes the V1 local validation; no other inventory source is used

lines.statement: Not available: unsold inventory has not been validated.

missing.reason: known sites only; not a complete pipeline

lines.statement: No site within 2 km in the known list. Known sites only; not a complete pipeline.

lines.label: Quiet-area check
lines.statement: Not a quiet area. 624 resales within 2 km in Oct 2025–Sep 2026, more than 27 of 51 similar developments.

lines.label: Market backdrop
lines.statement: Condo and EC resales within 2 km: 624 in Oct 2025–Sep 2026 against 726 in Oct 2024–Sep 2025 (−14%). Planning-area private resales −4.5%. Observed transactions, not a prediction.
